slides.title: Resupply hypothesis: preserve the stereochemical input
bullets: Downstream synthesis depends on the correct chiral intermediate being available.
Resupply must preserve the required stereochemical quality as well as provide isolated material.
The practical route gate is release of usable intermediate, not preparation of a proposed analogue.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Purity: keep the measures distinct
bullets: Enantiomeric purity was assessed against the agreed specification.
The resupply met that specification.
This readout records the release conclusion without quoting an unsupported measured value.
bullets_right: General chromatographic purity and enantiomeric purity answer different questions.
An area-percent result alone must not be used as a substitute for the chiral assessment.
Keep the delivery-lot identity with the analytical release information.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Isolation and handling route risk
bullets: Preserve the intermediate identity through work-up and isolation.
Maintain the link between isolated material and its release assessment.
Avoid treating an unreleased preparation as interchangeable with the released delivery lot.
A repeat resupply requires its own release decision.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Delivery lot: available for downstream synthesis
bullets: The released resupply removed the material constraint on Elvarmere’s downstream route.
Use the delivered intermediate as the reference point for subsequent preparations.
Keep consumption and remaining stock on the compound card.
Material quantities are governed by the delivery documentation, not estimated from this deck.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Chemistry and release handover
bullets: Hassan Darwish: campaign B preparation and route context.
Clara Fenwick: analytical release and specification context.
Ruth Calderwood: closure of the resupply route gate.
bullets_right: Elvarmere Biosciences AB: downstream synthesis restart.
Maintain the intermediate-to-delivery-lot link when material is subdivided.
Refer route changes back to the resupply sequence before requesting further material.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Boundary of the conclusion
bullets: The agreed enantiomeric-purity specification was met.
The client’s stalled synthesis was restored by the resupply.
No downstream product yield, activity or final-product release is asserted here.
Any next analogue requires a separate preparation plan.
slides.footer: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | Confidential

slides.title: Campaign B closed
bullets: Close VD-22-076 as completed on 24 Oct 2022.
Retain the released intermediate as the basis for future resupply discussions.
Carry the stereochemical specification into any repeat campaign.
Review the next material requirement against the downstream sequence before reopening preparation.
